 In The High Court Of Orissa At Cuttack

 Mr. S. Padhee, Advocate

01. 1.

entities.text: High Court Of Orissa At Cuttack
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the Petitioner and learned counsel for the State.

2. The Petitioner is seeking pre-arrest bail in connection with C.T. Case No.23 of 2019 pending on the file of learned Sessions Judge-cum-Special Judge (POCSO) Act, Bargarh, arising out of Barpali P.S. Case No.145 of 2019 for commission of offence punishable under Sections 341/ 323/ 342/ 395/
294/354/363/376(2)(n)/376(3)/506/34 of IPC read with Section 6/12 of POCSO Act and Section 3(1)(r)/3(1)(s)/3(2)(v)/3(2)(va) of SC and ST (POA) Act.
3.

In the light of the order passed by this Court in the case of Pramod Kumar Ray and others Vrs.
State of Odisha, (2017) 67 OCR 309, this ABLAPL is disposed of with the following directions.
The Petitioner shall surrender before the learned Court in seisin in the aforesaid case within three weeks from today.

entities.text:
Pramod Kumar Ray and others Vrs.
State of Odisha, (2017) 67 OCR 309
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Seven days before the surrender of the Petitioner before the said Court, the Petitioner or his counsel shall serve a copy of the bail application or such number of copies of the bail application on the learned Public Prosecutor/Special Public Prosecutor, as required by him, for the purpose of notice to the Victim and/or Informant.

4. Taking into consideration the nature of the offence as alleged against the Petitioner, it is directed that the Petitioner shall be released on interim bail by the learned Court in seisin, on the same day he surrender in the aforesaid case, pending disposal of the bail application on merit, on such terms and conditions as deemed just and proper including the following conditions:-
Santosh Kumar Jena vs State Of Odisha .... Opposite Party on 10 March, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/52319847/
1 I) The Petitioner shall appear before the I.O. once in a week on the date and time fixed by the said I.O. until further order by the learned Court in seisin;
II) The Petitioner shall not threaten, induce or coerce any witnesses of this case or the Victim; and III) The Petitioner shall not involve himself in similar or any other offence during currency of this order.

entities.text: Santosh Kumar Jena vs State Of Odisha
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 5. Within two weeks of appearance of the Victim and/or Informant, the matter shall be considered and disposed of on its own merits.

6. Ground of parity, if any, may be considered by the learned court below if the same is canvassed by the learned counsel for the Petitioner at the time of consideration of the bail application.
7.
The ABLAPL accordingly stands disposed of.
(V. NARASINGH) Judge Ayesha Location: High Court of Orissa, Cuttack Santosh Kumar Jena vs State Of Odisha ....

II) The Petitioner shall not threaten, induce or coerce any witnesses of this case or the Victim; and III) The Petitioner shall not involve himself in similar or any other offence during currency of this order.
